title: Strategic Starting Vertices in Competing First-Passage Percolation
statement: In competing first-passage percolation on a finite-variance configuration model, can a weaker type capture a positive fraction of the vertices when it starts from high-degree vertices and the stronger type starts from a low-degree vertex?
